verdict.rationale: Asana's own docs show task creation through the API quick start and through its MCP server's natural-language task management, and a 'tasks due this week' query implies due dates exist. Community users describe it as a task-list and project-management tool used by developers. Assignment is only hinted at, via a third-party Bitbucket sync listing assignees. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of assigning tasks to teammates, explicit documentation of setting due dates, hands-on corroboration of the assign-with-due-date flow.
